name: University of International Relations
supervisors: Ministry of State Security (per a 1997 Zhejiang provincial notice)
Ministry of Education (its listed supervising department)

evidence.summary: A 1997 notice from Zhejiang’s provincial personnel, public security and state security departments names the University of International Relations, with Jiangnan Social University, as a school belonging to the Ministry of State Security (MSS), and sets out how its graduates are recruited as police officers into the province’s public security and state security organs.

China’s official graduate admissions website lists the Ministry of Education as the university’s supervising department, and the university’s own website describes it as a school under that ministry, while the 1997 Zhejiang notice names it as belonging to the MSS.
